Definition: an earthen vessel; usually (painful) toil; also a pang (whether of body or mind)
BiblicalUsage: 1) pain, hurt, toil, sorrow, labour, hardship; 1a) pain; 1b) hurt, offense; 1c) toil, hardship; 2) vessel, creation, object; 3) (TWOT) idol
